statement: The incidence of Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) is associated with maternal pre-pregnancy health care utilization levels.
rationale: This study design uses a case-specific rate approach to estimate the association between maternal pre-pregnancy healthcare utilization and SUID incidence. The numerator comes from SUID cases, while the denominator comes from live births stratified by pre-pregnancy healthcare utilization levels.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10 discusses limitations of vital-record data, similar to our case series. bedsharing_ms_v7.C17-C24 highlight observational study limitations and indirect denominators, but do not address pre-pregnancy health care utilization directly.
required_concepts: Live births stratified by pre-pregnancy healthcare utilization levels
cannot_establish: Causation, detailed mechanisms linking pre-pregnancy healthcare utilization and SUID incidence.
